pages.title: Finding Eximite
pages.text: Default deposits: End, Y 0 to 128. Veins target up to 7 blocks, with 10 placement attempts per chunk. Mining requirement: level 4.

pages.title: Working Eximite
pages.text: Smelt Eximite Ore or Eximite Dust into ingots. Crushing the ore first normally yields two dusts. Ingots can be stored as metal blocks or converted into the material's other crafting forms.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 789 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 5.$(br)Mining efficiency: 7.8.$(br)Material damage bonus: 4.9.$(br)Enchantability: 28.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 3, chestplate 4, leggings 4, boots 3.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 3.0.$(br)Enchantability: 28.

pages.title: Armor: End Domestic
pages.text: Shulkers become neutral, but you're not immune to the effect of lingering bullets.

pages.title: Weapon: Outworlder
pages.text: Grants bonus damage and a looting effect to mobs in the End.
